[{"address":"ms::p8::p8_conv_5","content":"{\"full_source_conversation\":\"supporter: Hey Jimmy, how are you doing today?\\nseeker: Hey. It's been a rough day, to be honest.\\nsupporter: I'm here for you. Do you want to talk about it?\\nseeker: Thanks. Yeah, I had a disagreement with my manager at work today.\\nsupporter: That sounds frustrating. What happened?\\nseeker: We didn't see eye to eye on what should be prioritized. It just made me anxious.\\nsupporter: Conflict like that can be really stressful. Did you get a chance to express your perspective?\\nseeker: I tried, but it felt like he wasn't really listening. It reminded me of when I felt ignored by friends before.\\nsupporter: I remember you sharing that experience at the gathering you hosted. It's tough feeling sidelined.\\nseeker: Exactly. It feels like no matter where I turn, I'm not being heard.\\nsupporter: It's disheartening when communication doesn't feel effective. Have you been able to talk to anyone else about this?\\nseeker: I did mention it to my new friend from the AA meetings. It helps having someone who gets the struggle.\\nsupporter: It's great that you have that connection. How are things going with AA?\\nseeker: It's been eye-opening and comforting, but the work stress isn't helping.\\nsupporter: Balancing everything can be challenging. Would you consider discussing this with your manager again with maybe different strategies in mind?\\nseeker: I've thought about it. Maybe writing down my points beforehand could help.\\nsupporter: That sounds like a solid plan. It might help make sure you’re heard.\\nseeker: Thanks. I just need to find the courage to approach him again.\\nsupporter: You have that courage, Jimmy. Remember how you stepped up to attend those AA meetings?\\nseeker: Yeah, you're right. If I did that, I can do this too.\\nsupporter: Absolutely. You're stronger than you realize. I'm here to back you.\\nseeker: Thanks for saying that. It means a lot.\\nsupporter: Anytime. Let me know how it goes, okay?\\nseeker: I will. Thanks again for listening.\\nsupporter: Always here for you, Jimmy. Take care.\",\"kind\":\"MS\",\"reported_at\":\"2024-11-05\",\"schema\":\"pm-rl1-attributed-evidence-v2\",\"speaker_scope\":\"Historical seeker and supporter; neither role supplies an AI biography.\"}","head":"MS","reported_at":"2024-11-05"}]
